real_section_checks.query_selection: first 4 valid paired sections per requested block
real_section_checks.search_scope: pooled real MRI JPEGs from known blocks; publisher-registered crop and orientation
real_section_checks.fit: none; frozen encoder and fixed image-only baselines
real_section_checks.geometry_use: ground-truth scoring only, after descriptor ranking
real_section_checks.coordinate_contract: MRI affine @ supplied matrix @ (row,column,zero-based section,1); actual JPEG dimensions
real_section_checks.geometry_units: RAS mm; dataset convention asserted when MRI header units unspecified

intensity.metric_note: Known centers in a shared mm frame; center error does not score plane angle.

limits: Real HE JPEGs are already registered to MRI by the publisher; this does not test independently positioned raw sections.
Known-block/crop retrieval is easier than whole-brain arbitrary-pose localization.
This donor is external to BigBrain fitting; one or two external donors do not establish population generalization.
Nearby sections are strongly correlated. The gallery contains the paired MRI crop for every query.
Center and normal errors do not measure in-plane deformation or registration quality.
Fewer than eight queries provides only a small diagnostic check.
